definitionOfFull: Full means comprehensive project architecture and broad statutory inventory for the defined Kincardine study scope. It does not claim that every asset has a complete building history, condition survey or verified building footprint.
knownLimitations: The listed-building coordinate index is a practical snapshot and must be refreshed against HES.
Official conservation-area, scheduled-monument, designed-landscape and listed-building boundary polygons are imported live rather than approximated.
Historic-map candidates require exact sheet identification, licensing and service URLs.
The pre-bridge shoreline and ferry landing need period-specific georeferenced reconstruction.
A building-by-building survival and integrity survey is required before treating the heat map as a definitive historic-character assessment.
Several dates are authoritative century or part-century ranges rather than exact construction years.
A dated lintel or panel may record a building phase or rebuilding rather than the first construction of the whole listed group.
